def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required = set(case['required_symbols'])
    # Build maps
    node_map = {}
    children_of = {}
    for n in nodes:
        nid = n['id']
        node_map[nid] = n
        children_of[nid] = []
    for n in nodes:
        p = n['parent']
        if p is not None:
            children_of[p].append(n['id'])
    # Initialize retained set
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    # symbol frequency
    symbol_count = {}
    for n in nodes:
        sym = n['symbol']
        symbol_count[sym] = symbol_count.get(sym,0)+1
    # Sort removable nodes: depth descending, id ascending
    removable_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['removable']]
    # sort by depth descending, then id ascending
    removable_sorted = sorted(removable_nodes, key=lambda x: (-x['depth'], x['id']))
    removal_order = []
    for node in removable_sorted:
        nid = node['id']
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        # Check retained children
        has_retained_child = any(cid in retained for cid in children_of[nid])
        if has_retained_child:
            continue
        # Check required symbols after removal
        sym = node['symbol']
        symbol_count[sym] -= 1
        ok = True
        for req_sym in required:
            if symbol_count.get(req_sym,0) == 0:
                ok = False
                break
        if not ok:
            symbol_count[sym] += 1  # revert
            continue
        # Remove
        retained.remove(nid)
        removal_order.append(nid)
        # symbol count already decremented
    # After processing, no need to revert symbol_count for kept nodes
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removal_order,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted
    }
